title: onprem/airgap: vendor rke2 & flatcar updates + offline bundle tooling improvements
description: Motivation: customers running the Private installer in air-gapped environments have reported issues with RKE2/Flatcar compatibility and stale vendored images in the offline bundles. This PR updates the vendoring workflow, refreshes RKE2/Flatcar compatible images, and improves the offline bundle generation scripts and Helm chart defaults to reduce manual post-install steps. Summary of changes: 1) Updated vendor manifest for rke2 (v1.24.12+rke2r2 -> v1.24.15+rke2r1) and Flatcar channel references; 2) Added image checksum verification and auto-retry to installer/scripts/vendor-images.sh; 3) Regenerated offline bundles for rke2 and k3s targets and added a new installer/offline-bundles/rke2/flatcar/README.md with distro-specific notes; 4) Helm chart tweaks: new values for rke2.kubelet.extraArgs and tolerations for control-plane on Flatcar; 5) Terraform module docs updated with new variables for airgap_registry and bundle_version; 6) Added upgrade/rollback playbooks and smoke tests (tests/onprem/offline-smoke.sh). Backwards compatibility: bundles are additive; older bundles still supported but customers should prefer the new bundle for RKE2+Flatcar clusters. Checklist: - [x] Update vendor manifests - [x] Add checksums and retry logic - [x] Regenerate offline bundles - [x] Update Helm defaults and docs - [x] Add smoke tests - [x] CI green (after rerun) Release notes: see release_notes field. Related Linear: ENG-1278, ENG-1353.

Priya Anand: Added the note and included a recommended systemctl mask step for the Flatcar kernel-upgrade.service in README.

release_notes: On-prem/airgap: refreshed RKE2 (v1.24.15+rke2r1) and Flatcar vendoring in offline bundles; added checksum verification and retry logic to vendor scripts; Helm chart defaults improved for RKE2 on Flatcar; new upgrade/rollback playbooks and offline smoke tests. Customers running older bundles should upgrade to the new bundle for improved compatibility and automated validations.
notes_for_ops: Operator should re-run installer/scripts/vendor-images.sh with the new bundle_version and ensure airgap_registry credentials are available; if using Flatcar, follow README note to mask kernel-upgrade.service during maintenance windows.
ci_logs_summary: Initial CI: failed (offline-smoke.sh flaky). Rerun after regenerating bundles: all checks passed (lint, unit, integration, offline-smoke).
testing_instructions: 1) Generate offline bundle locally using installer/scripts/vendor-images.sh --target rke2 --distro flatcar --bundle-version v2026-02-28; 2) Load bundle into airgapped registry and deploy terraform module with airgap_registry set; 3) Run tests/onprem/offline-smoke.sh against the provisioned cluster; 4) Verify Helm values.yaml rke2 settings applied to kubelet and control-plane nodes.
notes: This PR was driven by a customer support case (SUP-4210) where the previous bundle did not include a patched rke2 image. We coordinated with the infra team to expand CI smoke coverage for air-gapped installs.
